LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_DevouredPawnHolder.label: [Raven] Womb Distension
LanguageData.Raven_Hediff_DevouredPawnHolder.descript: A living person is imprisoned in the deepest reaches of this Raven's body. Warm, slick, fleshy walls grip and envelop the prey's entire body. Immersed in thick bodily fluids, the prey loses all resistance, as if returned to the womb, sinking into total time stop in absolute depravity.
